leads.name: 1000-jährige Eiche Bad Blumau
leads.why: Well documented tree, locally nicknamed 'die dicke Oachn', standing in Bierbaum an der Safen at the end of the Eichenweg toward Loimeth (municipality of Bad Blumau, Steiermark), on a private plot ('auf einem privaten Grundstück, Ortsende von Bierbaum, nach der kleinen Kapelle' per meinbezirk.at) but treated as a public attraction with marked trails, information signage and guided tours (per meinbezirk.at's Hartberg-Fuerstenfeld article, 'thousands of annual visitors'). Species and measurements from baumkunde.de's tree register (dendrology enthusiast database, last visited/measured 09.08.2018): Stiel-Eiche/Pedunculate Oak (Quercus robur), girth 8.75m (875cm) at that visit, height 30m, coordinates N47 6.32538' E16 2.94798' (converted: 47.105423, 16.049133), status 'vital' and 'öffentlich zugänglich' (publicly accessible). AGE IS DISPUTED, both figures kept rather than one picked: baumkunde.de gives 500-600 years as its own measurement-based estimate and explicitly flags this as contradicting the popular name; meinbezirk.at's Hartberg-Fuerstenfeld piece instead states 'Experten bestaetigen: rund 1.000 Jahre alt' and repeats the legend that it was 'allegedly planted around the year 1020'. No source states which experts or method reached the 1000-year figure, so it reads as the same unverified local tradition rather than an independent dendrological measurement; baumkunde's girth-based figure is more likely the sounder one but I am not picking a winner. Alive: meinbezirk (graz community edition) reports a lightning strike in the 1970s that was clumsily filled with concrete, causing decay, and a restoration in 1989 by tree surgeon Manfred Saller funded by a donation from Heidi Horten, after which 'the oldest oak in Europe shines again in full vitality'; baumkunde's 2018 visit independently confirms 'vital' condition. Clears the bar: alive and vital as of the two most recent checks (1989 restoration outcome, 2018 measurement), two independent sources for species/age/location that actually disagree on age (flagged rather than resolved), one collectible point, publicly reachable despite private ownership of the plot. Sources: https://www.baumkunde.de/baumregister/1309-tausendjaehrige_eiche_in_bad_blumau/ ; https://www.meinbezirk.at/hartberg-fuerstenfeld/c-lokales/die-1000-jaehrige-eiche-von-bierbaum_a7441969 ; https://www.meinbezirk.at/graz/c-regionauten-community/die-1000-jaehrige-eiche-in-bierbaum-gemeinde-bad-blumau_a5050954
